title: Haunted Mansion
content: Not the Disney one, which I do love. I have had a reoccurring dream place my entire life. It's second empire style. It feels like a place I have always known and belonged to. Like maybe this place has always been there and I have always lived there at certain points in each life and every version of me in the multiverse. It's also haunted, think American Horror Story or Ghosts (CBS/BBC). It can warp your sense of self, time, and put you through insanity and back when first becoming reaclimated. Like a series of tests to be sure you are you and you fit here . There's a children's library in one of the upper most rooms that is haunted by a young girl named Sarah Emma and she changes which she likes to be called. It is my favorite room as I spent a lot of time there as a kid and grew close to her. However, the staircase to it is often blocked, under construction, or missing. My room is always in the tower. The house usually is on a green hill in a set of rolling hills but also can be among the city (set up like New Orleans set up or STL). It often disguises itself when in the city as an old museum house or old house turned small art museum.
